title: When Semantic Caches Lie: False Hits, Downstream Cost, and Calibration in Embedding-Based Caching for Large Language Models
description: Code, the labeled cache-equivalence dataset, and reproduction scripts for the study of reliability and cost-aware calibration in embedding-based semantic caching for LLMs. Regenerates every figure and table in the accompanying manuscript on CPU with fixed seeds.
